title: Three-level hierarchy
statement: Define Level1 with a Value method that returns 1. Define Level2, which extends Level1 and overrides Value to return super.Value() plus 10. Define Level3, which extends Level2 and overrides Value to return super.Value() plus 100. Read a level number (1, 2 or any other value for 3), create the object of that level and write its Value.

assertions.requirement: The statement asks you to solve it with a class.
